definitions.explanation: A small shelter or lodge built on a mountain, used by hikers and climbers for rest or overnight stays. In Japan, many mountain huts are commercially operated and offer meals and bedding during hiking season.

examples.japanese: {山小屋|やまごや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泊|と}まった→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: I stayed at a mountain hut.

examples.japanese: ⟦{頂上|ちょうじょう}→頂上：03493_choujou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近|ちか}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{山小屋|やまごや}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a mountain hut near the summit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{登山|とざん}→登山：03457_tozan⟧⟦シーズン→シーズン：10944_shiizun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{山小屋|やまごや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{埋|う}まる→埋まる：01897_umaru⟧。
examples.english: During the summer climbing season, mountain hut reservations fill up quickly.

notes:
{山小屋|やまごや} refers to shelters built on mountainsides or at high elevations for hikers and climbers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {山小屋|やまごや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泊|と}まる→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧ — to stay at a mountain hut
- {山小屋|やまごや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}する→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧ — to reserve a mountain hut
- {山小屋|やまごや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}→休憩：00262_kyuukei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to take a break at a mountain hut

In Japan, many {山小屋|やまごや} on popular peaks like ⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧ are staffed and offer meals, unlike simple unmanned shelters ({避難小屋|ひなんごや}) which are free but have no services.
